a thick soft cover, filled with feathers, that you sleep under

steps.title: Отметь, чему научился
items: ✓ describe a thing when you cannot remember its name — It’s something that…
✓ define a person — He’s the man who cleans our street
✓ define a place — It’s the room where you hang your clothes
✓ choose between who , which , that and where
✓ avoid repeating the subject — not the man who he lives here
✓ name the things in a home — duvet, sheet, towel, wardrobe, tap, pan, rug
